Faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
Faq.a0: MenuList gives your menu and business information one official customer-facing version. The public menu and related customer links stay aligned around the version you approve.
Faq.q1: Do I need to be technical to use it?
Faq.a1: Not at all. MenuList is built for business owners, not developers. You add your items, set your prices, and publish. MenuList prepares the QR assets, formatting, and public pages around the menu you approve.
Faq.q2: What happens when I update a price or item?
Faq.a2: You update the menu in MenuList and publish the approved version. Customer-facing links then show the current version without chasing old PDFs or scattered screenshots.
Faq.q3: Can I use my own branding and colors?
Faq.a3: Yes. Your menu inherits your business colors, font preferences, and logo. The public-facing menu looks like yours — not like a generic template.
Faq.q4: What types of businesses use MenuList?
Faq.a4: MenuList is built first for restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens, bakeries, salons, spas, and other businesses with customer-facing menus, service lists, or price lists.
Faq.a5: Yes. MenuList runs on Google Cloud / Firebase infrastructure with TLS encryption on connections. Your data is isolated at the database level, and access is controlled through account permissions. For Google sign-in, MenuList does not store a password for that account. See our Trust & Security page for details.
Faq.a6: Yes. MenuList supports multi-location control so a brand can keep shared menu truth, branding, and public presence aligned while still allowing location-specific differences when needed.
Faq.a7: MenuList lets you start with a 7-day setup so you can review the public menu before choosing a paid plan to keep the same link live and updated.
Faq.q8: Will this guarantee Google or AI search placement?
Faq.a8: No. Search engines and AI systems decide what they crawl, cite, and show. MenuList prepares your official page and menu as clear, structured public business information so those systems have a better source to read.
Faq.q9: Can staff use MenuList without getting full owner access?
Faq.a9: Yes. Owners can create staff accounts, assign roles, reset staff passcodes, and sign out staff access when someone leaves. Staff can use only the areas their role allows.
Faq.q10: Can I import my existing menu link?
Faq.a10: Yes. After sign-in, you can paste a public menu link you own or have permission to use. MenuList prepares a draft for review, so the link becomes a starting point rather than another public version to maintain.
Faq.q11: Will imported menu content publish automatically?
Faq.a11: No. Imported content stays in review until you approve it. If a source cannot be read clearly, you can upload a menu photo or file instead, or edit the menu manually.
Faq.q12: Does AI Menu Manager change my menu automatically?
Faq.a12: No. AI Menu Manager prepares cards. Important work such as prices, bulk updates, publishing, and generated images needs owner approval before it goes live.
Faq.q13: Is AI Menu Manager a customer chatbot?
Faq.a13: No. It is an owner-side menu operations feature. Customers do not chat with it. Owners use it to prepare menu updates inside MenuList.
Faq.q14: Can staff use AI Menu Manager?
Faq.a14: Staff access depends on the permissions the owner gives them. High-risk work still follows approval rules and cannot bypass owner-controlled access.
Faq.q15: Can it update Zomato, Swiggy, Google, or Instagram directly?
Faq.a15: Only when a supported first-party adapter exists. Otherwise MenuList prepares a manual task, export, or copy/share card so the external step is clear.

AiMenuManagerPage.cardBody: Selected project: Main Menu. Scope: current store. Publishing will be prepared after approval.
AiMenuManagerPage.flowTitle: Message in. Card prepared. Approval first. Receipt after.
AiMenuManagerPage.flowSubtitle: AI can understand the owner request, but registered MenuList actions control what can be prepared and what can be applied.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow0Desc: The owner types or speaks a menu change in normal language.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow1Desc: MenuList shows the item, scope, before and after state, and customer-facing impact.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow2Desc: Prices, bulk work, publishing, generated images, and risky changes wait for approval.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow3Desc: Approved work uses the existing MenuList save, import, image, publish, cache, and receipt paths.

AiMenuManagerPage.opsTitle: Built for menu work, not random chat.
AiMenuManagerPage.opsSubtitle: Every executable request maps to a registered MenuList action type. Unsupported external work becomes a clear manual task, not a fake done state.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops0Desc: Prepare single-item or bulk price, sold-out, visibility, and status cards from the selected menu.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops1Desc: Prepare today specials, banners, special menus, and publishing work with the right approval level.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops2Desc: Generate drafts and apply them only after the owner chooses to use them on the menu.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops3Desc: Use existing menu import and extraction review paths instead of overwriting live menu data.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops4Desc: Turn style requests into previewable changes using MenuList design controls.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops5Desc: Zomato, Swiggy, Google, Instagram, and similar destinations stay manual unless a real supported adapter exists.
AiMenuManagerPage.safetyTitle: AI prepares the work. You stay in control.

AiMenuManagerPage.safety0Desc: Price changes, bulk updates, publishing, generated images, and risky work require explicit owner approval.
AiMenuManagerPage.safety1Desc: Approved work uses existing MenuList save, image, import, publish, cache, and receipt behavior.
AiMenuManagerPage.safety2Desc: Unsupported external posting is shown honestly as a manual step or export handoff.
